purpose: Make component, D1, calibration, sufficiency, and tripwire outcomes mechanically decidable and mutually exclusive.

adjusted_bound_authority.upper: simultaneous studentized-maxT one-sided 95% upper bound from max_h(-t_h_star)
adjusted_bound_authority.block_sensitivity: lower=min across {3,5,8}; upper=max across {3,5,8}; p=max across {3,5,8}
adjusted_bound_authority.equality: Use the exact threshold ownership defined for each statistic; no floating narrative override is allowed.

resolver.algorithm: Evaluate all required predicates, collect flags, then return the first true route in terminal_precedence. If no earlier flag is true and every all-required pass predicate is true, return the context-specific success terminal. Any unclassified required predicate is invalid_evidence.
resolver.combined_system_success_context: At FT2-80 only, replace entry_component_freeze_pass with combined_system_incremental_edge_pass after every signed combined-system predicate passes.

invalid_evidence_any: authority, upstream, ledger, model, calibrator, composer, control, simulator, fee, or packet hash mismatch
feature/target leakage, role collision, outer-validation feedback, protected-holdout access, or wrong population
missing, duplicate, or inconsistent session/decision/contract/fold identity
wrong action space, fill law, fee trajectory, WAIT denominator, neutral lifecycle, D48, D49, soft-close, daily stop, or forced flat
producer statistic cannot be independently reproduced
a required D1 control is generated with the wrong seed namespace, algorithm, attempt count, redraw, replacement, or outcome-conditioned matching
a valid strong-shuffle control has significant adjusted positive increment over its valid matched-random control
a mandatory action-conditioned head, target, calibrator, or artifact is missing or unreproducible
the MNAR no-bid sensitivity output is missing or unreproducible

D1_matching_failure_modes.case: control implementation or identity violates the frozen algorithm
the algorithm is valid but any of the eight fixed schedules is incomplete at pre-outcome construction
all schedules construct validly but any fixed schedule fails one or more signed post-replay exposure bounds
all schedules are valid and a strong shuffled model has adjusted p<=0.05 and adjusted lower bound>0
all schedules and shuffled controls are valid; real-candidate lower bound<=0<upper bound for a required dollar contrast
all schedules and shuffled controls are valid; real-candidate adjusted upper bound<=0 for a required dollar contrast
all schedules and shuffled controls are valid; real-candidate adjusted lower bound>0 and adjusted p<=0.05 for every FT2-80 comparator

pooled_DeltaQ_component_quality.pass: adjusted lower bound>0 and adjusted p<=0.05
pooled_DeltaQ_component_quality.no_signal: adjusted upper bound<=0 and corrected-ESS MDE<=0.05
pooled_DeltaQ_component_quality.insufficient: otherwise when the interval contains zero, MDE>0.05, or ESS is below the frozen minimum

chronological_fold_direction.positive: point estimate>0 against every required quality comparator
chronological_fold_direction.sufficient_negative: point estimate<=0, adjusted upper bound<=0, fold corrected-ESS MDE<=0.05, and fold raw sessions>=20
chronological_fold_direction.ambiguous_negative: point estimate<=0 but adjusted upper bound>0, MDE>0.05, or raw sessions<20

seed_robustness.every_seed: positive pooled DeltaQ and at least four positive folds against required quality comparators
seed_robustness.sufficient_seed_failure: seed adjusted upper bound<=0 and seed MDE<=0.05

quality_family_and_DeltaU.sufficient_harm: family adjusted upper bound<0 and family MDE<=0.05
quality_family_and_DeltaU.ambiguous_harm: family point<0 but upper bound>=0 or MDE>0.05

side_phase_month_volatility_regime.eligible: at least 20 raw sessions and statistic-specific corrected ESS>=10
side_phase_month_volatility_regime.sufficient_negative: adjusted upper bound<0 and stratum MDE<=0.05
side_phase_month_volatility_regime.ambiguous_negative: point<0 but upper bound>=0 or MDE>0.05
side_phase_month_volatility_regime.low_denominator: descriptive_only unless it is the only evidence for a required route, then insufficient_evidence

serial_dollar_no_harm_vs_P5.pass: adjusted lower bound>=0 and adjusted one-sided p<=0.05 on both $3 and $4

FT2_80_incremental_dollars.pass: adjusted lower bound>0 and adjusted one-sided p<=0.05 versus both P5 and exposure-matched random
FT2_80_incremental_dollars.ambiguous: lower bound<=0<upper bound or adjusted p>0.05

bounded_fifth_fold_attribution.purpose: Allow at most one negative fold only when a preregistered composition factor quantitatively explains it; free-text stories and sampling_uncertainty codes are forbidden.
bounded_fifth_fold_attribution.reference_weights: For the preregistered factor, compute bin session weights from the other four folds combined; no outcome values enter weights.
bounded_fifth_fold_attribution.negative_fold_bin_means: Compute the paired session delta mean within every factor bin in the negative fold.
all_required: exactly one of five fold point estimates is negative
abs(negative fold point)<=0.5*positive pooled point estimate
negative fold unadjusted two-sided 95% interval contains zero
every preregistered factor bin has at least 3 sessions in the negative fold and positive reference weight
session-block adjusted 95% lower bound for attribution_gain>0

resource_owner_route.trigger: mde_spec.json first GPU tranche gate fails because measured pilot MDE exceeds the census-v2-based planning bound or required pilot measurement is absent

owner_tripwire_route.trigger: tripwire_spec.json relative-capture, four-bucket, or harvest tripwire breaches with valid sufficient denominators

all_required_component_pass: all three seeds and frozen ensemble pass
fold, family, and regime rules pass or the single fifth fold passes quantitative attribution
G4, D48, D49, soft-close, daily-stop, ruin, one-position, and fee trajectories pass
serial-dollar exact no-harm versus P5 passes
all multiplicity and independent-reproduction requirements pass
acceptance_test: Two independent implementations consuming the same canonical toy packet must emit the same terminal string and the same ordered list of triggered predicates.
